parsed.explanation: National tier-1-adjacent exposures: entry cable directs refusal on any sex discrepancy (stranding, latent permanent fraud bar, though no documented imposition), foreign-government advisories issued, and documented custody harm (conversion-therapy-style federal prison policy, immigration abuse). Facilities bans reach many states (some criminal, one arrest documented, held in men's ward), but 29+ states lack them in mapped categories, so not universal nationally. Weighed against: no criminalization of trans identity, functioning courts enjoining several orders, national employment and hate-crime protections, no documented killings or violence campaign, legal-aid infrastructure. Social climate is mixed-to-hostile (66% support birth-sex documents). Worst feature is document/custody exposure with partial remedy — elevated risk band, above the 0.35 anchors because protections operate and criminalisation is absent, below 0.60 because exposures are national or widespread and remedies incomplete.
